Step 1

Ghost, seat, ticket…

Null, index, format, mismatch, file.

📸

Bouncer’s photo wall. NullPointer (ghost), IndexOutOfBounds (wrong seat), NumberFormat (forged ticket), InputMismatch (wrong currency), FileNotFound (wrong hall). Check IDs AT THE DOOR.

ProgramRead each line in order
String name = null; // ghost guest arrives
if (name != null) {
  System.out.println(name.length());
} else {
  System.out.println("Name missing - using Guest");
}
int[] a = {1, 2};
int want = 5;
if (want >= 0 && want < a.length) {
  System.out.println(a[want]);
} else {
  System.out.println("No seat 5");
}

Two detonations converted to two sentences.

null name
Using Guest
Fallback
seat 5?
No seat 5
Guarded
BUGS get fixed (null where impossible). EVENTS get handled (users lose files).
